# tebibcloud_database (Data Source)

Looks up a managed Postgres database by ID or by name. The owner's password is only known to the `tebibcloud_database` resource that created it, so it is not exposed here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A database made elsewhere (the console, the CLI, another configuration).
data "tebibcloud_database" "app" {
  name = "app"
}

output "database_host" {
  value = data.tebibcloud_database.app.host
}

output "database_ca_certificate" {
  value = data.tebibcloud_database.app.ca_certificate
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) database ID.
- `name` (String) Name to look up.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Default: the provider's `project`.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The private address inside the VPC (port 5432).
- `allow_all` (Boolean) Whether every address may connect.
- `allow_list` (Set of String) Addresses or CIDRs that may connect over the internet.
- `backup_enabled` (Boolean) Whether backups (and point-in-time restore) are on.
- `backup_retention_days` (Number) Days of backups kept.
- `ca_certificate` (String) The database's CA certificate (PEM), for `sslrootcert`.
- `cpu_millicores` (Number) Exact CPU of an instance: 500 is half a vCPU.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `disk_gib` (Number) Disk per instance in GiB.
- `disk_used_bytes` (Number) Bytes used on the disk (null until measured).
- `fallback_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a fallback port is open for clients without direct TLS.
- `fallback_port` (Number) The fallback port (null while off).
- `host` (String) The platform host name: use it with `sslmode=verify-full`.
- `maintenance_window` (String) Weekly four-hour window for minor updates (UTC), e.g. `sun-02`.
- `memory_mib` (Number) Memory of an instance in MiB.
- `mode` (String) `single` or `ha`.
- `plan` (String) Plan code, e.g. `b1.micro`.
- `port` (Number) The port, 5432.
- `postgres_version` (String) The Postgres version running, e.g. `18.6`.
- `power_state` (String) `running` or `stopped`.
- `public_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the database is open to the internet.
- `public_host` (String) The public host name (empty while the endpoint is off).
- `region` (String) Region code, e.g. `neo`.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state.
- `subnet_id` (String) The subnet of the private address's proxy pods.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags.
- `trn` (String) TRN.
- `vcpus` (Number) Whole vCPUs of an instance.
- `version` (Number) Postgres major version.
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC whose VMs connect.
- `zone` (String) Zone code in the region, empty if the platform didn't pick one.
